title: Listening Drill — School garden trial
description: Fieldwork briefing. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: School garden trial
sections.transcript:
LEADER: Let me explain how we'll collect data about growth in the school garden. Each pair will have the same instructions. That matters because another group needs to be able to repeat what you've done.

LEADER: Start with the bean plot. Record the first reading at two. The quantity we're comparing is stem length. Use the ruler marked with blue tape.

LEADER: At the end, repeat one measure to check your result. If you miss a reading, mark it as missing. Don't fill in a number by copying the nearest result.
